title: ReadyAt, Null Until Baked
description: The moment a report actually finished baking is worth recording separately from when it was requested — and until that moment arrives, the column should honestly say it hasn't happened yet.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs. Querying report_jobs via `npm run db:psql` immediately confirms ready_at IS NULL. Poll GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id until status becomes "ready", then re-query the same row and confirm ready_at is now NOT NULL and is a timestamp after created_at.
hints: readyAt is only set inside the queued job's success branch, right alongside setting status to "ready" (apps/api/src/modules/reporting/service.ts) — the two always change together.
The queue delay is NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS (default 500ms, see docs/self-host.md) — poll with a short interval rather than a single fixed sleep.
